title: Design: Sending invoice lists the Bill To's contact ticked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A with one contact marked Billing, and customer B with its own contact.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A.
  • Start on the work order's Finance tab.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p5-12-after-sending-invoice-s2-17581.png, bt-p5-11-before-sending-invoice-s2-17581.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Sending invoice window lists customer A's contact (name and email) ticked; customer B's contact is not listed.
  • "Include 'For Customer' Attachments in email" is unticked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12311 (Story 9, Invoice email to the Bill To)

  • S9-R1: “The send window lists the Bill To's contacts.”
  • S9-R2: “It pre-ticks the Bill To's contact marked Billing, else its first contact A to Z by name.”
  • S9-R4: “"For Customer" attachments behave as today: sent only when staff tick the box, which starts unticked.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "5 Getting paid", pictures "Sending invoice (S2-17581)" (This build), "Sending invoice (S2-17581)" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
